mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 33 degrees down at Fireman's Park under a waning crescent moon. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 32 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

The city has announced pavement repairs starting this Tuesday, November 10, and continuing through Wednesday, November 11. Crews will be milling and patching streets including North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, with no parking allowed from 7 AM to 7 PM.

There is a full slate of local events coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run today and at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow. You can also visit the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square or check out Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday.

In a report regarding noteworthy calls from last month, on October 25, officers responded to a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. A man was taken into custody for an O W I offence.

Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 26 minutes, so head over now if you want to grab a scoop before they shut down for the night.
